product: Wooting analog keyboards (read only: model, size, layout)
works: written from docs/brands/wooting.md (Wooting's own wooting-rgb-sdk) and checked against a simulated keyboard only (tests/sim-wooting.mjs)

profiles (community protocol only), firmware updates (Wootility only)
